name: instagram_create_media
description: Stage a post without publishing it. Instagram fetches the media from the URL itself and returns { id } — a container id, not a post, and nothing is public yet; instagram_publish_media --creation_id is the call that publishes it. Pass either --image_url or --video_url, never both, which is why the schema requires neither. The URL must be a public HTTPS URL Instagram's servers can reach: a path on this machine cannot be used, and JPEG is the only image format that works. Video, reels and stories are processed asynchronously — poll instagram_media_status until status_code is FINISHED before publishing. A container expires after 24 hours. If this fails, read the error and stop; call it again only with the thing you actually changed.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a JPEG. Instagram downloads it from there, so a local path does not work and neither does PNG, HEIC or WEBP. Mutually exclusive with video_url.

video_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of an MP4 or MOV. Mutually exclusive with image_url; needs media_type REELS or STORIES.

media_type.description: 'IMAGE' (the default, so it can be left off for a feed photo), 'REELS' for video, 'STORIES' for a 24-hour story, 'CAROUSEL' for a parent holding children.

caption.description: Caption text, up to 2200 characters and 30 hashtags. Not used on stories or on a carousel child — the carousel parent carries it.

children.description: Comma-separated list of up to 10 container ids, each created with --is_carousel_item true, e.g. '17..1,17..2'. Only with media_type CAROUSEL.

is_carousel_item.description: Mark this container as a child of a carousel rather than a post of its own. A child is never published directly.

alt_text.description: Accessibility description, images only. Up to 1000 characters.

thumb_offset.description: Which video frame to use as the cover, in milliseconds from the start.

share_to_feed.description: For REELS: also show the reel on the profile grid. Default true.

is_ai_generated.description: Set this when the media was generated rather than photographed. Instagram labels the post.
